faq.q: Is Titanium Pipeline Repair Sleeve compatible with subsea cathodic protection systems?
faq.a: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V does not require cathodic protection (CP) in seawater. If CP is present from adjacent steel structures Titanium Pipeline Repair Sleeve will not suffer hydrogen embrittlement at potentials more negative than -1050 mV (Ag/AgCl). However, direct electrical connection to aluminum anodes should be avoided for subsea pipeline repair as overprotection (>-1100 mV) can cause hydride formation.
